QuestInfo.name: [Sellas] Testing the Waters
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Neinheart to proceed with the operation.
QuestInfo.1: Shubert, who apparently once served in Edelstein's diving unit, is in command. Follow him into the submersible.
QuestInfo.2:
Ollie had said the sea was murky, but it's actually clear and beautiful.
Use the Jellyfish's instruments to search for Tana's relic.
